newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank of China HK Branch FRCD attracts 61 banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China HK Branch FRCD attracts 61 banks.

text.p: Sixty-one banks participated in Bank of China Hong Kong Branch's floating rate certificate of deposit issue, the borrower said on Friday.
The issue was increased to HK$4 billion from HK$2 billion after being oversubscribed by 4.5 times in syndication.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with no put or call options. It pays an all-in return of 41.5 basis points to top-tier managers.

Senior lead managers are ABN Amro Bank, Asahi Finance Hong Kong, BA Asia, Banca Commerciale Italiana Hong Kong, Banque Nationale de Paris Hong Kong, Bayerische Landesbank, Bear Stearn Asia, Chase Mahattan Aisa, Citicorp International, Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft Hong Kong, Daiwa Securities, Dao Heng Bank, DKB Asia, Dresdner Bank Hong Kong, Fuji International Finance (HK), Hang Seng Bank, HSBC Markets, IBJ Asia, ING Bank Hong Kong, J.P Morgan Securities Asia, Jardine Fleming Bank, LTCB Asia, Mitsubishi Trust Finance Asia, Natwest Markets, Oakreed Financial Services, Sakura Finance Asia, Sanwa International Finance, Schroders Asia, Societe Generale
Lead managers are Bayerische Vereinsbank Hong Kong, Ka Wah Bank, Nippon Credit International and Royal Bank of Scotland .

Co-lead managers are Banca di Roma S.P.A Hong Kong, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro S.p.A Hong Kong, Banco Exterior de Espana, Bank Brussels Lambert Hong Kong, BZW Asia, Credit Italiano S.p.A Hong Kong, Daiwa Overseas Finance, Generale Belgian Bank and Paribas Asia.

Managers are Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft Hong Kong, Bank of East Asia, CARIPLO S.p.A Hong Kong, China Construction Bank, CIBC CEF, Credit Lyonnais Hong Kong, Liu Chong Hing Bank, Michinoku Finance Hong Kong, Nomura International Hong Kong, Tai Fung Bank Wing Lung Bank, and Yamaichi International (HK).
